name: Mutated Brown Mold OLD
source: Pathfinder Society Special #3-98: Expedition Into Pallid Peril
description: This unassuming fungus leeches heat out of the air.
disable: DC 25 Survival (trained) to safely remove the mold
reset: After expanding, the brown mold can't grow again for 1 day.

generalAbilities.name: Emit Cold
generalAbilities.description: 10 feet. Enhanced brown mold deals (2d8+7) Cold Damage damage to nearby creatures.

generalAbilities.name: Leech Warmth
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger Fire comes within 5 feet of the brown mold.

Effect The brown mold expands into every square adjacent to its space. As it grows, it pulls more heat from its surroundings, dealing (4d8+14) Cold Damage damage (Basic DC 24 Fortitude Saving Throw save) to creatures within 15 feet after it expands.
